F01.title: Add-on-only menus show in existing schools on the older app plans
F01.cause: Existing schools (Sunrise = Starter app plan, St. Mary's = Pro) are gated by plan rank. Dashboard, the three desks, Transport, Web & App Screens, Templates, Appearance and Timings have rank 1, so every plan gets them. Only demo and client schools use the add-on rules.
F01.fix: Store tier + bought add-ons on every school and derive menu switches from them with the same function demo/client schools use; migrate seed schools by mapping app plan to tier.

F02.title: Admission numbers and student IDs can repeat
F02.cause: admitStudent numbers new students from students.length + 1. After any student record is removed (for example an import rollback), the next admission gets a number already in use.
F02.fix: Number from a sequence counter (db.seq.admission) that never goes back; add a unique check (database already has a unique key, so the API would error).

F03.title: No duplicate check for admissions and enquiries
F03.cause: Neither the New Admission form nor admitStudent/addEnquiry look for the same child (name + date of birth + guardian mobile).
F03.fix: Before saving, look for a match and show “Possible duplicate: <name, ADM no.> — save anyway?”; same for enquiries by child name + parent mobile + grade.

F04.title: Staff short code can duplicate an existing one
F04.cause: StaffForm checks mobile/email duplicates but not the timetable short code, which the timetable clash check relies on.
F04.fix: Refuse a short code already used by another active staff member (case-insensitive).

F05.title: Dates are not checked for plausibility
F05.cause: Date fields check only presence. Date of birth can be in the future or give an age that does not fit the class; joining date can be 2099; portfolio dates can be in the future or impossible (2026-13-45).
F05.fix: Date of birth: not in the future, age 2.5–20 and within ±2 years of the class’s usual age (warn, not block, outside that). Joining date: not more than 6 months ahead. Portfolio date: real date, not in the future.

F06.title: Names made of spaces (or digits and symbols) are accepted
F06.cause: Required checks test `!f.first`, so "   " passes. Add user then creates an account whose name is blank after trimming.
F06.fix: Trim before the required check; names allow letters, spaces and . ' - only (any script).

F07.title: Negative or unrealistic numbers are accepted
F07.cause: Question marks have no lower bound (−2 saved, which breaks paper totals); Payment Matching “Add” only checks that amount is filled (−₹500 allowed); basic pay has no upper bound.
F07.fix: Marks 1–20 whole numbers; incoming payment amount > 0; basic pay ≤ ₹10,00,000 a month with a confirm above ₹3,00,000.

F08.title: A parent request can be saved for a child who is not theirs (business layer)
F08.cause: submitRequest does not check that the student is one of the signed-in parent’s children; only the screen limits the choice.
F08.fix: In submitRequest (and the API), refuse unless studentId is in user.children.

F09.title: Business rules live only in the screens
F09.cause: recordPayment accepts 0, negative or text amounts and UPI without a reference; addEnquiry accepts a blank name/mobile; proposals save a malformed contact email. The forms block these, but imports, the public form and the future API call the same functions.
F09.fix: Move each form rule into the matching lib function (one source of truth) and keep the form check for instant feedback.

F10.title: Duplicates allowed for events, library books and curriculum units
F10.cause: addEvent, addBook and addUnit do not look for the same title on the same date / author / class+subject.
F10.fix: Warn “already exists — add copies instead?” for books; refuse identical unit names in one class+subject; warn for same event title on the same date.

F11.title: Small validation gaps
F11.cause: Homework subject not required; an online class can be booked today at a time already past; library copies 2.5 accepted; curriculum periods 2.6 silently saved as 3; expense 12.345 is shown as “Twelve only”.
F11.fix: Require subject; refuse past times today; copies whole numbers; round periods/amounts and show the corrected value before saving.

F12.title: Mobile numbers typed with +91 or spaces are refused (or cut off)
F12.cause: Admission mobile has maxLength 10, so “+91 98450 12399” is cut to “+91 98450 ” and refused; the pickup list refuses it outright. The sign-in field already normalises the same input.
F12.fix: Proposed auto-correction (needs your approval): strip spaces, dashes and a leading +91/0, show “Saved as 9845012399”.

F13.title: Needs decision: Accountant can open Student Profile
F13.cause: The seeded department “Accounts & Finance” includes Student Profile (guardian contacts, attendance, marks), wider than the Accountant role list.
F13.fix: If not intended, remove STU_PROFILE from that department, or give Accountant a fees-only student view.

F14.title: Needs decision: Custom roles are on for every tier
F14.cause: demoConfig always switches on FN_CUSTOM_ROLES, which the older app plans gave only from Pro+.
F14.fix: Decide whether custom roles are a basic feature, part of Pro+, or a paid add-on; then set it in the rate card.
